title: S&P 500 closes at record 7,799 as July CPI matches estimates
summary: S&P 500 added 0.65% to close at an all-time high of 7,798.99 on Aug 12 after July CPI came in at +0.1% monthly / 3.4% annual, matching estimates. Core CPI +0.2% / 2.5% annual. Nasdaq gained 0.81% to 26,803. Brent oil fell >2% on the session.
why: Benign CPI data raises probability of Fed rate cuts; broadly positive for equity valuations and sell-put premium direction on tracked US names (NVDA, INTC, GOOGL, COST, WMT).

title: Hang Seng posts worst weekly loss in over a year amid renewed tech selloff
summary: HSI fell 1.8% to 22,671.86 on Aug 14, capping a 5.2% weekly loss — worst since Apr 11, 2025. Hang Seng Tech Index -3.4%. Key drivers: Fed hawkishness, investor demand for AI monetisation proof amid surging capex, weak China consumer confidence weighing on internet platforms.
why: Sharp HK market selloff directly impacts tracked HK-listed names: 腾讯 (0700.HK), 美团 (3690.HK), 小米 (1810.HK). Elevated implied vol may create sell-put entry points.

title: China tech earnings: hardware stocks gain momentum as internet platforms lag
summary: Bloomberg synthesis of early Q2 2026 China tech results: hardware and chip firms (SMIC record revenue) gaining momentum; internet platforms (Tencent capex surge, JD.com first revenue decline) still facing consumer-demand headwinds. Market watching if hardware rally can sustain.
why: Sector rotation signal between hardware/chips and internet platforms — relevant to 腾讯, 阿里巴巴, 小米, 美光, 英伟达 positions and portfolio weighting decisions.

title: JD.com Q2: first revenue decline since 2014 IPO as China consumer demand weakens
summary: JD.com Q2 2026: net revenue RMB346.4B (-2.9% YoY), the company's first quarterly revenue decline since listing in 2014. Operating income turned positive to RMB4.5B (vs. RMB-0.9B in Q2-2025) after throttling the food-delivery price war. Profit beat estimates.
why: JD's first revenue contraction flags broad China consumer weakness — direct read-through for tracked e-commerce and consumer peers 阿里巴巴 (BABA), 美团 (3690.HK), 拼多多 (PDD).

title: SMIC Q2 revenue crosses $3B for first time; net profit +262% YoY
summary: SMIC Q2 2026 (per HKEXnews filing 2026081300353): revenue +36% YoY to $3.0B, first quarter above $3B; gross margin 25.3%; net profit +262% YoY to $479M. AI chip demand and domestic substitution drove results amid continued US export restrictions.
why: SMIC's landmark quarter validates China domestic chip demand cycle — bullish signal for semiconductor sector and thematic read-through for 美光 (MU), 英伟达 (NVDA), AI supply-chain positioning.

title: Unitree Robotics IPO 5,526x oversubscribed; Shanghai STAR Market listing week of Aug 17
summary: Unitree's Shanghai STAR Market IPO retail tranche was subscribed 5,526x, with 9.8M orders totalling 8.1T yuan ($1.2T). IPO priced at 150.8 yuan/share; raised $900M at ~$9B valuation. DeepSeek is a strategic investor. One of the most oversubscribed IPOs in China's history.
why: Record IPO subscription signals peak retail frenzy for AI/robotics in China A-shares; thematic read-through for 小米 (robotics/AI hardware) and AI capex narrative supporting 英伟达, 英特尔.

title: Tencent Q2: revenue +11%, AI capex surges 65% QoQ to $7.8B; stock -26% YTD
summary: Tencent Q2 2026: revenue +11% YoY on WeChat ad surge; domestic games +17% YoY; AI capex jumped 65% QoQ to 52.8B yuan ($7.8B) as Tencent defends potential 'superior' AI returns. Cloud grew low-twenties % YoY. Stock has fallen 26% YTD on investor concern over rising AI spending.
why: Tencent (0700.HK) is directly tracked. Accelerating capex raises near-term FCF risk but games and ad growth are positive long-term signals. Persistent IV elevation may create sell-put entry; watch 0700.HK levels.

title: SanDisk Investor Day: ~80% non-GAAP gross margin target FY2028-30; $94B in NBM contracts
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) 2026 Investor Day: targets ~80% non-GAAP gross margin and ~75% operating margin for FY2028-30, with mid-to-high teens revenue CAGR. New Business Model (NBM) framework: 8 signed deals, $94B total contract value, floor pricing, 4+ yr avg contract duration. Plans 100% excess cash return FY2028-30. Stock +544% YTD; JPMorgan upgraded to overweight, $2,250 PT.
why: SanDisk (SNDK) is directly tracked. Multi-year margin target and $94B contracted revenue structurally de-risk sell-put positions and support higher-strike selection. NBM floor pricing reduces cyclicality.

title: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20B at $95/share; demand exceeded $100B
summary: Intel upsized its equity offering from $15B to $20B at $95/share on Aug 10 after the order book exceeded $100B, signalling strong investor appetite for AI foundry capacity. Proceeds fund AI-oriented manufacturing expansion.
why: Intel (INTC) is directly tracked. Large dilutive offering (~$20B) pressures near-term EPS but validates massive AI foundry demand; monitor sell-put strike exposure and delta at current INTC levels.
